coarse_geographic_comparison.conditional_overlap_note: Under radians for the LA corner attributes, the coarse LA scene envelope overlaps the WRF bounding envelope; a scene rectangle is not a target-pixel footprint match. The lower-right corner is slightly south of the WRF min-lat envelope. No pixel row/column was matched.

read_only_method.netcdf_fields_read: wrfinput global attributes, Times, and XLAT/XLONG 2-D coordinates; wrfbdy global attributes and Times only; forecast Times variables only; no atmospheric state arrays scanned except XLAT/XLONG.
read_only_method.large_file_sha_policy: Only existing receipt hashes reused. No new SHA over 100 MB WRF files or WRF executable was computed.

readiness_conclusion: Existing July 19 00:00 native IC and boundary records through 09:00 can support a future model integration spanning the July 19 05:34 LA / 06477D candidate window without obtaining a replacement model dataset. This is not a time-matched observation/model pair: phase, selected pixel, pixel clock, exact navigation correspondence, and a time-resolved retained model state remain open. Do not attribute the separate hourly 12 h file to the pinned C5 run or use it as exact target state.
